the canonical XBE's .text address in upstream's edition check, compared as a number (compiled out of retargeted builds)
loose upper bound for return addresses in a stack walk; the code of both regions ends below it
rough windows of game data the trainer's [HDIFF-G] snapshot compares, and their sizes
table sizes (one slot per guest address below 4 MB)
